name: Quality Trust 2599 2.5 Inch SATA III HDD SSD External Enclosure USB-C Black
shortDescription: Quality Trust 2599 2.5 Inch SATA III HDD/SSD External Enclosure USB-C Black Edition (USB Type-C Interface / Up to 10Gbps High-Speed Transfer with UASP Protocol / Tool-Free Installation / Automatic Energy-Saving Dormancy
descriptionHtml:
Quality Trust 2599 2.5 Inch SATA III HDD/SSD External Enclosure USB-C Black Edition (USB Type-C Interface / Up to 10Gbps High-Speed Transfer with UASP Protocol / Tool-Free Installation / Automatic Energy-Saving Dormancy / Durable ABS Plastic & Polycarbonate Casing / Portable Lightweight Design)

Turn your internal 2.5-inch hard drive or solid-state drive into a fast portable external storage device with the Quality Trust 2599 2.5 Inch SATA III HDD/SSD External Enclosure USB-C in Black, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Crafted from durable ABS plastic and polycarbonate with a glossy finish, this screwless tool-free enclosure features high-speed USB Type-C connectivity supporting up to 10Gbps transfer rates via UASP protocol, making drive installation and data management fast, efficient, and effortless.
